entries.0db2e7b70da8426e: In the food business, it states that the Kanto Daiichi plant fully recovered in April 2025, establishing a stable supply system, and that it will expand sales channels. As a new supply base for western Japan, it is building a new Kyushu plant in Miyakonojo City, Miyazaki Prefecture, scheduled for completion in December 2026. In the restaurant business, it states that it will expand openings in the Kanto region while using cooking robots at Osaka Ohsho, and will advance franchise expansion at R Baker, backed by a central kitchen in Kōshu City, Yamanashi Prefecture.

entries.1df46fce01d8392a: A defining feature is the combination of the food and restaurant businesses as its two pillars. Leveraging the brand recognition of Osaka Ohsho for frozen gyoza sales, it makes gyoza fillings and wrappers at group plants and delivers them to directly operated and franchised restaurants, linking manufacturing with store operations. Frozen gyoza is also manufactured under contract by partner producers that have established traceability and inspection systems.

entries.c57b7e4b4e569d6f: A business that operates company-owned restaurants centered on the popular Chinese cuisine brand Osaka Ohsho, as well as the ramen shops Yotteko-ya and Taiyo no Tomato-men, the bakery cafés R Baker and Koshiniru, and the Ippinko restaurants specializing in tanmen noodles, and develops its own brands through franchise chains. As of February 28, 2026, the number of stores totaled 471, comprising 117 company-operated stores and 354 franchised stores, and external customer revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥17,259 million.
entries.dbb5441c3b2fc631: It has set a long-term vision, “Eat＆Challenge 2030,” aiming for global revenue of ¥100 billion toward 2030. Its medium-term 3-year management plan “Sustainable Growth 2024” extended its final year to fiscal 2026 (the fiscal year ending February 2027), and it sets a revenue target for fiscal 2026 of ¥43 billion. It states that it will strengthen business portfolio management, deepen both its restaurant business and food business, expand store openings in overseas Asia, begin restaurant ＥＣ, and explore new businesses to become future pillars through business complementation via Ｍ＆Ａ and alliances.

entries.fe04edab37c364a8: A business that manufactures and sells frozen foods and others under the Osaka Ohsho brand.
